crossRefs.note: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each…
Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word…
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision…
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.
translations.bsb: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man’s silver to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. This order was carried out,

translations.asv: Then Joseph commanded to fill their vessels with grain, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provisions for the way: and thus was it done unto them.
